text:
The court will likely sustain the government's objections and exclude the records. The defendant's conclusory statement that he kept them "on a regular business basis" does not lay the FRE 803(6) foundation, nor does it authenticate the computer output under FRE 901(b)(9), so the records remain hearsay offered for their truth. The team note is not an accurate statement of the rule: FRE 801(d)(1) excludes a testifying witness's prior statement from hearsay only in narrow categories (inconsistent, consistent-to-rebut, or identification), not whenever the declarant is available to testify.

CONFIDENCE: 62
